title: Verify ping import chain works end-to-end
body: After all previous stories are implemented, run `pytest tests/agile/test_ping.py -v` and confirm the test passes. Also verify `python -c 'from orgos.agile import ping; print(ping())'` prints `pong`. This is a verification story: only record results, no code changes.

votes.justification: This is purely a verification story requiring no code changes, only running existing tests and a quick import check. As Architect, I estimate it as trivial (<30 minutes) because the implementation is already in place and acceptance tests should pass immediately.

As Test, this is a purely verification story with no code changes, so effort is minimal. Risks are low since the dependency chain is simple, but I need to ensure the ping module is importable and the test environment is properly set up.

This story requires no code changes and only involves running a pytest command and a simple Python import test, both of which are fast and deterministic. Security risk is minimal as there are no new dependencies or modifications to introduce secrets.
